google_places.notes: DISABLED as of 2026-08-08 — every call currently returns 403 PERMISSION_DENIED. The existing GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY was provisioned for the legacy Places API (used by scripts/places_import/enrich_google.py), not the newer Places API (New) this integration calls. To re-enable: in Google Cloud Console, enable 'Places API (New)' and confirm billing is active on that key's project, then set enabled to true here. Pricing is an estimate for the Pro-tier Text Search fields this integration requests (location/displayName/formattedAddress/types) — verify the real rate at Google Cloud Console billing once enabled, since Google's field-tier pricing changes and wasn't fully confirmed as of this writing.
